notes.title: Second Update: Additional Language Support
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Archivist's Curse. We're delighted to announce the second update on Steam version of the game.

What's new?

 Japanese language pack is now included in the game 
 Transition speed in and out of areas have been tweaked
 QoL in crafting and shop; now it's possible to use items stored in Shared Stash
 Ultimates now doesn't have warm-up period. Once unlocked, it can be used from turn 1.
 Adjustments on Anna, Levia and Mi's skill behaviors


Some texts may show improperly due to the missing font. If it happens, please install all the Font files in the Font folder by right-clicking > Install before playing.

We'd like to know what you think about this new update (and the game in general), so don't hesitate to post your thoughts or your latest runs in the Hall of Pawnsmoor!
Also, if you find any bugs or glitches, we have a thread in the Community Hub where everyone can send a report there. We'll read every reports posted there, so please let us know when you find one.

We also have a Discord server where members can communicate and get more information about the game, its lore and everything related to it. Come join in!

That's all for now from us.
Cheers!

notes.title: First Update Is Now Here!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Archivist's Curse. We've gathered feedback and reports which results in the first update on Steam version of the game.

The first update addresses several bug fixes and adjustments around Alley Exploration encounters and drop rates.

General

 Added language support for JP language pack (the language pack will come in the next update)
 Slight changes on Formation, Status, Companions and Bestiarium screens
 Fixed missing information in certain skills
 Fixed BGM, BGS and SFX volume reset when closing Setting menu
 Fixed typos and incorrect informations on skills, items, armors and status effects


Battle

Non-boss battle now won't show combat rating report; only loot drops will show
New encounters in specific battle nodes
Raiders: Kobol
Raiders: Kemet
Raiders: Birdman
Raiders: Dragonkin
Raiders: Mixed
Raiders: Living Armor

Added Gargoyles in Koranot encounter
Fixed crash caused by the game registers nonexistent party member before battle starts
Fixed Death unable to perform special actions
Fixed trigger action would cause game to stuck when the battler is killed by counterattack means in the middle of action


Character

Fixed Ningrum's missing Master Staff upgrade
Aluna
Sleeper Bolt now doesn't apply Earthspire
Master Staff Upgrade enables Hydrostrike to apply Earthspire on targets

Thuriri
Reduced screenshakes when casting Elemental Cast

Nella (Dark)
Updated art

Julia
Fixed Scorch Strike damage deals way less than described in the description
Reduced screenshakes when casting Scorch Strike

NR
Added safety measure after battle that removes Mirage effect (and prevents Missing Resource glitch afterwards)


Equipment/Artifacts

 Damage return effect (i.e. Banded Mail effect, Shelonia's Fishbone) is now non-lethal
 Fixed Blue Incense effect that accidentally marks the wearer immortal when the effect is activated


Enemies 

Fixed glitch that prevents certain item drops on major bosses
Fixed crash when a character attacks Muro Lamentio in its first form (when its shield is up)


Known Issues

There's a minor glitch when Inventory/Stash and Curio system may result in softlock if both are triggered in Alley Explorations.


We'd like to know what you think about this new update (and the game in general), so don't hesitate to post your thoughts or your latest runs in the Hall of Pawnsmoor!
Also, if you find any bugs or glitches, we have a thread in the Community Hub where everyone can send a report there. We'll read every reports posted there, so please let us know when you find one.

We also have a Discord server where members can communicate and get more information about the game, its lore and everything related to it. Come join in!

That's all for now from us.
Cheers!
